title: Geedel Rotary Cheese Grater, Kitchen Mandoline Vegetable Slicer with 3 Interchangeable Blades, Easy to Clean Grater for Fruit, Vegetables, Nuts
description:
About this item
Makes Everything Simple : Just forget your bagged cheese! Only turn the handle for several times and get fresh shredded cheese, cutting the food twelve time faster and saving more time. Go ahead for your favourite recipes with this cheese grater
Premium Material : All parts of the rotary cheese grater are made of food grade ABS material, no BPA. The three blades are made of stainless steel, never dull or rust. Our rotary grater provides safe choice and ensures you can enjoy healthy food
Three Option Grater : The parmesan cheese grater finishes food preparation with slicing, shredding and grinding blade easily, which is perfect for grating cheese, cookie, peanuts, almonds, etc. for salad, hash brown, taco, smoothie and so on
Safe To Use : The cheese grater with handle protects your hands from all sides during use: the handle replaces your hands in rotating and the food pusher keeps your hands away from the blades
Subtle Design : The powerful suction base keeps the cheese grater firm on a clean or smooth counter-tops like marble, glass. Plus, the transparent barrel with an inclined curvature reduce jamming in the cheese shredder
Easy To Clean : This rotary cheese grater is detachable in all parts making it simple to clean, just wash it under a stream of water for a few seconds, also top rack dishwasher safe
